pages.text:
A failure without a sealed containment releases Fallout: radioactive dust that settles on the blocks round the reactor and drifts a little downwind each day, contaminating chunks. The dose is full under open sky and a tenth under a roof.
Contamination decays over in-game days: most of it within a few days, a long-lived share over a month (half-lives in the config).

# Contamination
Walking through contaminated ground or air contaminates you and what you hold; a hazmat suit takes most of it.
# Decontamination Shower
Mounted overhead, it washes players under it (two blocks below) and what they carry, using water and wearing out its HEPA Filter. Used filters are low-level waste.
